What changed in the new chat dock and Help?
The dock now spans the main column: 1128 px at 1440. It keeps a 420 px minimum, 560 px default and 760 px maximum; the optional tray adds 240 px. Help is a nav destination, not a dock tab.

What do you want to do?

HiveMind is a local multi-agent workspace. The HyperAgent plans; SuperAgents split the work; Workers execute; Subagents help read-only. Every risky action is approved or refused by name, and every run is recorded locally.
